dose.definition: Magnitude of the first-higher-mode drop against the healthy recording of the same campaign, in percent. The fundamental (2.750 Hz) is unchanged in every state, so the damage is local, and the first-higher mode is the one that moves.

H2.rules: cosine of the standardised response vectors, each against its own reference; magnitudes are never compared across experiments

predictions.statement: LUMO's mask magnitude rises with the dose, L0 < L1 < L2

predictions.detail: ASC |R(DAM 3) - R(DAM 4)| = 0.488 against a cross-dose step of 0.237; DESC |R(DAM 3) - R(DAM 4)| = 0.389 against a cross-dose step of 0.0293
predictions.statement: DAM 3 and DAM 4 share one dose, so their magnitudes agree (the same-dose gap is not larger than the cross-dose step)
the γ²/P/S block need not follow the dose

reading.comparison_role: descriptive: the same metric applied to two assets, not a transferability test

bautzen.verdict: no dose ordering survives the asset's own Holm family; the mask point estimate rises monotonically on ASC, DESC only

lumo.verdict: no dose ordering survives the asset's own Holm family, and the mask point estimate is not monotone on either channel
